method: Strictly verified copy of the packaged app with an isolated database and empty model directory. Native window captured and interacted with on macOS; display 860 by 670.
input: Settled native viewport. Pointer opened English, selected German and closed the menu. The window displayed German and Settings saved locally.
persistence: Read-only database observed de while GUI held its process lock. Normal Cmd+Q, packaged CLI verified de after quit, a new process showed German on reopen.
retained_failures: Prior packaged probe did not verify actual selection. Concurrent CLI read was refused by the GUI-owned database lock. Subsequent tool action was stopped after user changed app.
First pointer click in this run used a transient scroll position and did not open the menu. On the settled frame, the pointer route succeeded.
After a pointer opened the menu, a real Tab moved focus to Search settings while the popup stayed open. The keyboard path remains unverified.
limits: Screen, system audio and microphone stayed disabled.
Models, live speech, window keyboard acceptance and reference parity were outside this pointer trial.
